collection.description: A lantern goes out during a memorial: an omen, or a draft?

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: During a memorial, a lantern suddenly extinguishes. One villager calls it an omen; another blames a draft.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The ceremony continues and everyone remembers the deceased differently.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A cracked fitting is found, though some still find the timing meaningful.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The family decides the unlit lantern suits their grief.
